record.name: Droid Tech
record.description: Droid Techs are specialists in droid construction, programming, and maintenance, using their skills to create, modify, and control advanced robotic systems.

subclass_identity_profile.core_fantasy: Master droid engineers specialize in crafting and modifying complex robotic systems.

progression_tree.description: You can perform a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check to access and modify a droid's systems remotely.

effects.value: Use an action to hack into a droid's system, allowing you to change its programming or take control of it.

progression_tree.description: You can make improvements to a droid's design and functionality, granting it advantage on one ability check or attack roll of your choice.

effects.notes: The droid's advanced algorithms subtly adjust its processing speed, granting it a fleeting advantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

progression_tree.description: You can upgrade a droid's components, granting it additional hit points and resistance to one damage type.
You can create a functional replica of a droid, which can take the place of the original in combat and other situations.

effects.notes: The droid rapidly duplicates itself, releasing a swarm of smaller, identical mechanical drones that attack with equal ferocity.

progression_tree.description: You can evolve a droid's design, granting it a new form and abilities.

effects.notes: Upon landing a hit, the Engineer gains access to an alternate droid form. The Engineer can select from a list of available forms, each granting unique abilities and enhancements.

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: Assumes a defensive stance with arms raised and repulsor shield activated
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: Emitting a swirling aura of blue and orange energy around its body

prompt_schema.base_prompt: Generate an image of a droid engineer surrounded by various robotic components, showcasing their expertise in crafting complex systems
contextual_modifiers: Show the droid's eyes glowing with a soft blue light as it focuses on a specific component
Depict the droid holding a small console device with holographic displays and various tool attachments
